## Implementation notes

**Two-crate split** (ADR-0283 D1): `hh-ledger::replay` owns the verdict
fold + emitters + reconstruct + `key_lookup`/`stored_observation`;
`hh-control::replay` owns the deterministic re-drive (extract_recorded,
the Replay* ports, seeded `replay_from`); `hh-embed::replay_ops` owns
the `replay`/`counterfactual` ops.

**Recording rule = evidence** (D2): `deterministic` needs
`variant_declares` + every consumed source `confined_to_events` —
`model.call.completed` must carry `calls` + `response_ref`;
`control.clock.read`/`control.random.read` are the declaring variant's
nondeterminism record. `invalid` (never reconciled) on
`ReplayDivergence{at_seq, expected, got}`.

**`sub-{effect_id}` re-derivation** (D3): `act` intents name
`tool_call_id` only (I2); `extract_recorded` folds
`action.tool.proposed{tool_call_id→surface_id}` into
`RecordedInputs::proposed_surfaces` and `ReplayGate` re-mints
`submission_ref = sub-{effect_id}` when the resolved surface is the
submit surface — the recorded `stop{submission_ref}` reproduces
byte-equal.

**External cues = principal deliveries only** (D4): `external_cues`
carries `context.artefact.delivered{kind ∈ {instruction, capability}}`,
human `security.permission.decided`, `lifecycle.run.resumed`,
`control.budget.amended`, principal-cancelled `stop` — kernel-internal
deliveries (harness-rule nudges, `procedure_index`) are re-derived by
the driver, never re-fed.

**Downgrade-with-record** (D5, closes DF-S2.9-2): the ladder's
`effective_replay`/`downgrade_reason` is the honest surface; the report
never claims `deterministic` beyond the evidence; a strict
`CoverageInsufficient` knob is declined.

**`effects_by_key` durable tier** (D6): dispatcher checks in-memory
`DedupStore` first, falls through to `effects_by_key_view`/`key_lookup`;
a committed-key duplicate appends `action.tool.rejected{dedup}` +
`DispatchOutcome::Duplicate` with the prior effect_id and stored
observation.

**Fault seams declared, not free-form** (D7): `KillPoint::STAGE3_SET` =
KP-1…9/13/15; `inject_durability_faults` (KP-9), `arm_restore_kill`
(KP-13), `inject_kill_point` (KP-1…8 dispatch boundaries), KP-15 helper
death with runtime alive.

**Schema/`generated.rs` regeneration**: adding `replay`/`counterfactual`
to the implemented ops table changed the schema hash — the generated
client + schema export were regenerated (`hh-codegen`) and committed;
check-drift clean. Op error lists declare only closed-sum members
(`Refused{reason}` carries `variant_not_declaring` etc. — ADR-0178 D3
closed sum).

## Gap table

| check | verdict | note |
|---|---|---|
| CC1 (one scheme per concern) | PASS | the report is a ledger fold; the driver re-drives the variant — no second replay semantic |
| CC2 (authority conferred) | PASS | replay/counterfactual open arms under the session's own authority; `charged_to = instrument` |
| CC3 (nothing unpinned) | PASS | every consumed source must be `confined_to_events`; divergence names `{at_seq, expected, got}` |
| CC4 (language-neutral) | PASS | contract types are `Json`-level records; no toolchain names |
| CC5 (contract-only reach) | PASS | ops go through the ops table; the driver consumes only durable rows + declared ports |
| CC6 (tier monotonicity + removability) | PASS | check-removability green; no new tier surface added |
| CC7 (single schema source) | PASS | ops/types declared in `hh-embed-schema`; generated artifacts regenerated + drift-checked |
| CC8 (additive) | PASS | `resumed_at_ms` additive; ops-table flips declare already-registered ops; no member renames |
| CC9 (matched-budget-or-refuse) | PASS | `counterfactual` refuses a missing/malformed `MatchSpec` (`UnbudgetedArm`) and n<k designs |
| CC10 (home-plane boundaries) | PASS | verdict in hh-ledger, drive in hh-control, ops in hh-embed — no cross-plane ownership |
| variant-not-declaring posture | NOTED | `Refused{variant_not_declaring}` rather than a typed member — the closed sum is frozen per dialect (ADR-0178 D3); the reason string is the typed channel |
| op error lists | NOTED | declare only closed-sum members; `ReplayDiverged`/`VariantNotDeclaring`/etc. ride `Refused{reason}` |

## Evidence report

Both replay modes execute: `reconstruct` rebuilds views + env binding
without re-execution; `deterministic` re-drives the declaring variant
with executor calls = 0 by construction (the `ReplayGate` has no
executor). The `ReplayValidityReport` verdict ladder is a pure fold
rebuildable from durable rows. The counterfactual hook gates on a
parseable `MatchSpec` + `earliest_affected_seq`, opens paired factual +
counterfactual arms with `arm_role`/`charged_to = instrument`, and
lands the `ComparisonReport`. The kill-point battery runs KP-1…9/13/15
× the four effect classes against the recovery oracle; `effects_by_key`
+ the duplicate veto survive restart; the five recovery metrics compute
over durable rows (`n/a`, never 0).
